note: Bloomberg newsletter 30 Oct 2026 (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/newsletters/2026-10-30/why-electronic-arts-shut-down-bioware-and-cancelled-mass-effect), relayed by VGC 14:34Z and ten more outlets: EA had two costly sci-fi action games planned (the next Mass Effect and Star Wars Battlefront 3), chose Battlefront as more likely to succeed and closed BioWare; EA statement: decision after months of planning, review and analysis. Footage: Mass Effect Legendary Edition reveal trailer and two Star Wars Battlefront II Steam screenshots (EA; both Battlefront II trailers on Steam are letterboxed 816 rows or 720p, Jedi: Survivor's gameplay trailer is letterboxed 820 rows, so stills); Battlefront 3 is unannounced, so Battlefront II is stand-in, credited. Sound: our bed (reason): the reveal trailer's stretches measured effects-led on the runner (from 30 s 24.1% music, from 3.1 s 17.0% music, audio split refused), the Reel crosses two games (Mass Effect footage and Battlefront II stills) so no one trailer stretch fits both, as with the BioWare Reel of 21 Oct; the other Mass Effect Steam trailers are letterboxed.
block_ok: looked at 33.3 to 34.2 s at 10 fps: hard cut from the Legendary Edition title card to the purple space shot, no decode damage; shot 4 starts at 34.2 after the cut

output 19.83 to 20.57 s is inside the Kylo Ren still (Battlefront II Steam screenshot, 17.6 to 21.6 s, no cut): looked at the still, clean 1920x1080 JPEG, two long bright straight lightsaber blades on a dark ground are the straight edges the check reads; not decode damage
director: v1 18:42Z FIX: shot 0 window on Shepard's shoulder cut through the N7 badge (cover weak), moved to her face with look room on the side she faces (focus 0.82); shot 6 window showed only the crossed lightsabers, moved onto Kylo Ren's mask and the blades (focus 0.85). Lines, story order, credits, our bed and pace pass. | v2 18:58Z FIX (round 2): Kylo framing fixed; cover still armour only, since at 90.4 s Shepard's head is cut off in the 16:9 source itself. Cover moved to the krogan Grunt close-up (54.4 s, the shot sheet's clearest face), shot 1 trimmed to 52.4 to 54.2 so the image does not repeat, shot 2 moved to 55.7 s (the squad).
